name: specstream
description: Live web data for your agent: describe the data in plain words and get structured rows, every value linked to the page it came from.
suggestedPrompts: Find US startups that filed a Form D over $5M this month, with the amount and the SEC filing
Find dental clinics in Lisbon with online booking, with their website and phone
Keep a weekly list of GLP-1 clinical trials that are recruiting, with the sponsor and the trial page
